Hardwood Floor Cleaning Service

Hardwood floors are a beautiful addition to any home, offering timeless elegance and durability. However, over time, dust, dirt, and debris can accumulate on the surface, dulling the natural shine of your floors. Regular cleaning is essential to preserve the beauty of hardwood floors and ensure their longevity. Professional hardwood floor cleaning services can remove built-up grime while maintaining the integrity of the wood, leaving your floors looking as good as new. At Carpet & Duct Cleaning, we specialize in hardwood floor cleaning using industry-approved methods that are safe for your floors. Our team uses gentle, yet effective cleaning solutions designed to break down dirt and debris without damaging the finish or surface of your hardwood. Whether your floors are finished with polyurethane, varnish, or oil, we ensure that the cleaning method used is tailored to suit your specific floor type.

One of the biggest challenges with hardwood floors is maintaining their shine and preventing damage from improper cleaning. Using the wrong products or techniques can leave behind streaks, water damage, or even cause the wood to warp. Our experts understand the unique needs of hardwood floors and use the best equipment to gently clean and restore their shine. We also offer polishing services to give your floors a smooth, glossy finish that enhances their natural beauty. In addition to routine cleaning, hardwood floors may require occasional deep cleaning to remove built-up grime or stains. Over time, dirt and spills can seep into the wood, causing discoloration. Our deep cleaning service includes specialized treatments that penetrate the wood’s surface to remove stains, odors, and accumulated dirt, restoring your floors to their original luster. We also provide protective treatments to help prevent future staining and wear. Regular hardwood floor cleaning not only enhances the aesthetic appeal of your home but also improves the air quality by removing dust, allergens, and pet dander trapped in the wood’s surface. Our cleaning process ensures that your floors are free from harmful particles, creating a cleaner and healthier living space. Whether you need routine maintenance or a more intensive cleaning service, Carpet & Duct Cleaning is committed to providing professional, reliable hardwood floor cleaning that protects and restores your investment.

FAQs How often should I clean my hardwood floors? Sweep or dust mop daily to remove dirt and debris. Vacuum weekly using a vacuum with a bare floor setting to prevent scratches. Damp mop with a microfiber mop and a pH-neutral wood cleaner every 1–2 weeks. Can I clean hardwood floors myself? Avoid excessive water as it can cause warping and swelling. Do not use steam mops on hardwood floors; the heat and moisture can damage the wood. Use a microfiber mop dampened with a wood-specific cleaner. Avoid harsh chemicals like bleach, ammonia, or vinegar, which can strip the finish and dull the surface. How long does professional hardwood floor cleaning take? Most professional hardwood floor cleaning appointments take about 1 to 2 hours , depending on the size and condition of the area. Larger jobs or additional polishing may take a bit longer, but professionals will keep you informed about timing. Should I seal my hardwood floors after cleaning? Prevents moisture damage by creating a barrier. Enhances durability against scratches and stains. Maintains appearance by preserving the finish. How can I maintain the shine of my hardwood floors? Use furniture pads to prevent scratches. Place rugs in high-traffic areas. Clean spills immediately to prevent staining. Avoid direct sunlight to prevent fading. Re-finish every 3–5 years to restore the floor's shine and protect the wood.
